## Checklist

Before submitting:

- [ ] I identified the affected skill or repository area.
- [ ] I described the current behavior separately from the expected behavior.
- [ ] I provided reproduction information when possible.
- [ ] I did not claim tests or runtime validation that did not occur.
- [ ] I separated verified facts from assumptions.
- [ ] I removed passwords, API keys, tokens and private information.
- [ ] I checked existing issues for an obviously identical report.

Thank you for helping improve Godot Game Development Skills.
